## How I verified it

- [ ] `npm run test:frontend`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test:backend`
- [ ] A regression test for the behaviour change (fails before, passes after)
- [ ] For UI: screenshots in light and dark, English and Korean strings, keyboard check

## Safety

- [ ] Anything that writes files, saves a case or starts a run still stops at an approval card
- [ ] No customer data, API keys or licensed vendor files in the change
